overall_notes: Vendor responded with a single informal email only (no filled Excel template, no ISO certificate, no BCT test report attached). The entire commercial offer is three clauses in [L3]: "₹42/kg for the 5-ply, 38 for the 3-ply, rest same as last year, freight extra." No per-piece prices, no box weights, and no dimension-wise pricing were provided, so no line can be priced as an absolute per-piece amount. Interpretation applied: the per-kg rates are treated as blanket rates covering the 3-ply lines and 5-ply lines respectively; "rest same as last year" is treated as covering the categories not addressed by a per-kg rate (7-ply, 2-ply rolls, die-cut mailers/trays/inserts, partition sets, layer pads). Because "rest" is undefined, there is a competing reading in which the per-kg rates cover ONLY plain RSC boxes and all die-cut / converted items fall under "same as last year"; where relevant this ambiguity is recorded on the line. Even for the per-kg lines the landed per-piece cost cannot be computed without board weight per box, which the vendor did not supply. Questionnaire largely unanswered; Q01/Q03 answered only by reference to "Docs same as last year, you have them on file" - a claim, with no document attached and therefore no verifiable validity on the bid due date. Moisture claim "below 10%" fails the <=9% criterion. Price basis is ex-works/unclear since freight is explicitly extra with no amount. No price validity, no payment term acceptance, no LD acceptance, no capacity, no plant distance, no references given. Bid was sent 22-Sep-2026 21:47 IST, i.e. after the stated 6 PM cut-off on the due date sequence (due 23-Sep-2026 6 PM, so within date but note timing of receipt).
